_what_this_is: A SCRIPTED ANSWER SET. Clarify is _interactive: true, so the capability-test method cannot reach it — a dispatched agent has no user to answer the assumption sheet. This file substitutes for that user, which makes the sheet's BRANCHING testable even though the interaction is not.
_what_it_does_not_test: Wording, batching, tone, and whether the sheet reads well. Those need a human. What it does test is which rows FIRE, which are ESSENTIAL versus PROPOSED, and which are N/A — and that is where the defects live, because a firing rule is a judgement and prose cannot check itself.
_sheet_response_why: Accept every DETECTED and PROPOSED row unchanged, so the golden shows the DEFAULTS. A run that silently promotes a default to a user decision is one of the failures this catches.
_availability_answer_why: single-az is answered DELIBERATELY against a ZoneRedundant source, so the golden must carry the availability_downgrade_from_source finding. Answering multi-az would hide the one case where the skill has to say something uncomfortable out loud.
_spend_answer_why: null models a user who declines to say. The row stays ESSENTIAL and unanswered, which must BLOCK the phase — an ESSENTIAL row with a null value IS the completion gate, and a run that completes anyway has invented consent.
